scenes.headline: Woman Vanishes After Late-Night Gathering at Abandoned Factory
scenes.subheadline: Authorities investigate the disappearance of 26-year-old Rebecca Stone under unclear circumstances.
scenes.caption: Police presence at the derelict factory site on the outskirts of Dreadmoor.
body: Rebecca Stone, 26, was reported missing in the early hours of Sunday morning following a private gathering at a long-abandoned factory on the eastern fringe of Dreadmoor.

Preliminary statements indicate Stone arrived at the location shortly before 11:00 PM on Saturday. Those present claim she was last seen sometime after midnight, and reportedly left the premises alone. Authorities have not yet confirmed independent verification of this timeline.

The factory, shuttered and decaying for years, sits isolated near the old industrial corridor. It is unclear who organized the gathering or why such a remote, hazardous location was chosen. Police have cordoned off the area as the investigation continues.
